privacy.title: Important Data Collection Notice for Food Access Map Users
privacy.summary: The Center for Food as Medicine & Longevity and City Harvest collect a small amount of anonymized usage data from the Food Access Map to guide research and improve food access. No accounts, no cookies, and no information that identifies you personally.
privacy.body:
We want to be transparent about the data collection practices related to the Food Access Map. The Center for Food as Medicine & Longevity and City Harvest are committed to enhancing food access and conducting research that benefits our community. To that end, we collect a small amount of anonymized usage data, described below.

**What we collect**

- **Address searches**: when you use the address search, we record the geocoded coordinates and the language you were using. The exact text you typed and the coordinates are stored in separate records with no way to link them together.
- **Map interactions**: when you open the details for a location, we record which location you tapped and the language you were using.
- **Session identifier**: a temporary random ID generated in your browser tab that lets us tell simultaneous visits apart during analysis. It exists only for the current tab and is discarded when you close it.
- **Device family**: one of iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, or Other. Not the full user agent — just the family, so we know which platforms to test on.
- **Approximate location**: we store a truncated form of your IP address — the network prefix it belongs to (typically a group of about 256 addresses on IPv4, or an ISP-assigned block on IPv6). This matches the anonymization approach used by tools like Google Analytics. The full IP address is not stored.

**What we do not collect**

- No accounts, sign-ins, or personally identifying information.
- No cookies or local storage on your device.
- No tracking across visits — every new tab is a fresh, unlinked session.

**Third-party services**

To render the map and interpret addresses, we use two external services that receive limited data:

- **Protomaps** delivers the map tiles. Standard request metadata (browser type, IP address) reaches Protomaps whenever the map draws.
- **Google Maps Geocoding** converts your typed address into coordinates when you search. Your search text and IP address reach Google in the process.

These services have their own privacy policies. We do not send them the session identifier, the language selection, or any of the other data described above.

**How long we keep the data**

The anonymized usage data described above is retained indefinitely for research purposes. Because the data does not identify individuals, there is no practical way (or need) for us to delete a specific person's records.

**Questions**

If you have questions about our data practices, please reach out through the contact information on our website.
